description: We’re a group of high school students creating a space exploration game where players will be able to learn all about abandoned (but not forgotten!) space tech.
summary: Space Stories is an interactive, 2D and collectathon-style game where you get to explore the planets of the Solar system as an astronaut, set on finding and learning about the derelict yet not forgotten spacecraft of NASA and fellow space agencies alike on Mars, the Moon and in heliocentric orbit.
details:
About

Space Stories is a two-dimensional, collectathon-style game where the player gets to explore the Solar System as an astronaut, land on different planets and moons, and look for derelict spacecraft. Each collected piece of technology comes with an information sheet detailing its past mission and history, intergrading education into entertainment. With each discovery, the player will gain both knowledge and in-game achievements that can be later exchanged for cosmetics. Our team is keen on continuing development past the project deadline to add many more exciting features and quality-of-life improvements, such as implementing a soundtrack and voice assistance. We plan on moving the game into a different engine in the near future to make those additions possible.

The Spacecraft

We have compiled a lot of information from multiple (mainly NASA) resources to create easy-to-navigate information sheets on 30 derelict spacecrafts/probes, which the player is tasked with finding. Basic details such as launch date are organised into a simple table-style layout while the mission description is written in full sentences. Additionally, voice assistance will be available for an even easier experience.

Mechanics

The player is encouraged to fly around and land on each celestial body (the orbital speeds of which are all to scale) on their own, however a menu is available for better navigation and teleportation to the desired landing site. With each discovery, one is awarded with achievements to spend on cosmetics for the astronaut.

Art Style

All graphics are hand-drawn in an arcade-style aiming for a minimalist yet vibrant and high-definition design.

Our Mission

The prime objective behind our project is to inspire our audience, young pupils and students, to learn about the grandeur of the universe and how we, the player themselves, can interact with it and create innovative ways of propelling us into the future. Education is nothing unless it is applied to practice.
